title: Zoning text change for 801 Eleventh Avenue, Manhattan
summary: This measure amends zoning rules for the Special Hudson River Park District and Special Clinton District to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Area at 801 Eleventh Avenue in Manhattan. It is one of three related land use actions, along with a zoning map change and a special permit, that would allow a mixed-use residential and commercial development totaling 386,350 square feet of floor area.
